HubSpot Automation

  • Home
  • HubSpot Automation

HubSpot Automation

Orgits designs and implements automation across HubSpot's Marketing, Sales, Service and Operations Hubs—using native workflows, custom code actions (Node.js/Python), webhooks and Operations Hub data quality tools to eliminate manual RevOps work.

  • Marketing workflows (nurture, scoring, lifecycle)

  • Sales workflows (task creation, deal updates, alerts)

  • Service workflows (ticket routing, SLA, escalation)

  • Custom code actions (Node.js, Python, secrets)

  • Operations Hub: data quality, deduplication, formatting

  • Webhook & API orchestration

Automate the Revenue Engine, Not Just Tasks

We target high-impact RevOps processes—lead handoff, deal stage enforcement, territory assignment, contract generation, renewal tracking—building workflows with error handling, audit trails and governance.

Automation discovery maps current RevOps processes, identifies manual handoffs and quantifies time savings. Workflow design follows trigger-condition-action patterns with branch logic, delay actions and re-enrollment rules. Custom code actions extend native capabilities—external API calls, complex calculations, data transformations and AI-powered enrichment. Operations Hub data quality automation handles deduplication, property standardization, association fixes and calculated properties at scale. Webhook orchestration connects HubSpot to external systems bidirectionally. All automations include sandbox testing, version control, monitoring dashboards and rollback procedures. We provide admin documentation, runbook creation and quarterly optimization reviews.

Good automation is maintainable, observable and governed.

  • Workflow folders & naming conventions

  • Execution history & error alerting

  • Change management & approval gates
